description: Solo participant at the Delhi local event (Virtually), taking on Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots. I am building AgniSetu, a web app that joins 26 years of NASA FIRMS fire detections into one consistent burning activity calendar for any area, starting with stubble burning in Punjab and Haryana. Stack: Python, FastAPI, DuckDB, React, MapLibre. Working solo this weekend, but glad to hear from anyone with remote sensing or fire science experience who wants to review the method.
